Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

advancedif · evaluates: The AdvancedIF v2 benchmark evaluation uses o3-mini to check rubric criteria and labels a response correct only if all criteria pass; it reports category percentages and their average.

candidate.third11.advancedif.evaluation.v2

  • RIFL’s rubric-generator training is a separate process. Mercor’s later implementation uses a different judge and repeat configuration, so that protocol must not be substituted for the paper’s evaluator.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

advancedif · human annotation: The AdvancedIF v2 paper describes manually written prompts focused on instruction following; for multi-turn examples annotators first converse with a supplied model, and the collection retains final-turn prompts that trigger an instruction-following failure.

advancedif · human annotation: AdvancedIF pairs each prompt with up to twenty final-turn criteria written by the same annotator, and the paper describes subsequent rounds of human review.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

advancedif · dataset size: AdvancedIF’s v2 paper enumerates 402 explicit/complex instruction dialogs, 736 multi-turn carried-context dialogs and 507 system-prompt-steerability dialogs, totaling 1,645; rubrics for multi-turn dialogs are collected only at the final turn.
